title: After Whiskey With His Captors, Cuban Dissident Lands in a Miami Maelstrom
summary: The former political prisoner Luis Manuel Otero Alcántara is unpacking 4,000 paintings he brought to Miami from Cuba and dodging criticism from exiles who once welcomed him.
